display_title: Is a Friend of a Friend a Stranger?
description:
It’s been 10 years since she had a crush on her childhood friend. On the day that her childhood friend got engaged to another woman, Sylvia spent the night with her friend’s friend. “That day was definitely a mistake. But it shouldn’t have happened again.” “Why not? There’s nothing better than a kiss to comfort you.” He kissed her while lying on the grass. “You can use me in any way you want. I’m a good person, so I’m usually obedient.” “That’s not being good. It’s being spineless.” ‘Spineless.’ In fact, that’s something she didn’t have. Her heart, which she thought would never change even if she died, wavered after seeing a few affectionate and seductive words. “And then what if I really… like you?” Are we really… okay like this?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
